summary: First test pass of YABBAI.NETWORK V2 unified backend + hub. All 17 backend tests pass on the single-port gateway covering all 5 mounted services, kill-switch flow, reconciled income, compliance gate, AI brain (Claude via Emergent Universal LLM key), DeFi paper-only flags, and Ops dashboard. Frontend hub, AI console, and all three Python dashboards (revsys, defisim, opscockpit) load cleanly with zero console / page errors. Kill-switch engage→disengage works end-to-end from the UI through the backend. Safety invariants intact (admin-key auth, kill_switch boolean, reconciled income increases on manual sale, compliance issues raised on guarantee-style claims, custodial=false / real_funds=false on DeFi).
critical_code_review_comments: Hub kill-switch chip is an inline-onclick span (no data-testid). Functional, but adding data-testid='hub-kill-switch-engage' / 'hub-kill-switch-disengage' would harden future Playwright regressions.

/app/backend/server.py mounts revenue_system/unified_server.py whose endpoints sit under /api/revenue/api/... (double /api). Functional but slightly awkward URL shape; consider re-prefixing in a follow-up.
Universal LLM key is read at module import. If EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is rotated, backend will need a supervisor restart — acceptable for now but worth noting.
test_credentials: Revenue admin header X-Admin-Key: yabbai-director-key (prefilled in revsys and hub).
seed_data_creation: Each run of test_manual_sale_increases_real_income inserts one reconciled sale (qa1-<epoch>, $500 gross / $20 fee). This is by design — reconciled income is in-memory.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Next phases will add Supabase surfaces (/app, /os, /floor, /studio, /portal, /vault) and Google/Stripe/PayPal/Phantom settings. Those were explicitly deferred and not tested here. The unified gateway routes everything cleanly under /api/<service> on :8001; hub at /hub/index.html bypasses magic-link auth in preview. Re-use /app/backend/tests/test_unified_backend.py as the regression base.
